text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Melanocytic Nevus. The presence of bluish, non-blanching macules is inconsistent with cellulitis, which typically presents as an erythematous, warm, and edematous plaque. Given the newborn status and the specific description of the lesions, this finding points towards a benign melanocytic lesion rather than an acute bacterial infection.
